entities.summary: Zhejiang Sci-Tech University is a prominent public university in Zhejiang province. It has a long history and strong reputation, particularly in science, engineering, textiles, fashion design, and technology-related fields with engineering being its main focus. The university also offers programs in humanities (arts), economics, management, and law.
